rules.voice: the client's own subject and register, read from digest/ — not a generic news voice
never_invent: numbers presented as fact (enrolment, prices, dates, percentages)
named people — staff, customers, quoted experts
events with a date and a place
rules.test: If the client published this sentence unchanged, would it be false? If yes, do not write it.

shape.title: about 31 characters — the client's own average
shape.introtext: about 45 words, one paragraph, no heading
shape.fulltext: leave empty; a try-on renders listings, not article pages
